clusters.rationale: 3 source IP(s) share identical payload hash set (4 hashes) -- direct evidence of shared distribution infrastructure, not inferred from reputation.

1 source IP(s) with sessions containing only connect/banner/disconnect -- never attempted auth, never downloaded a payload. Reported separately as reconnaissance/scanning activity, NOT merged with payload-based clusters -- no evidence connects them.

248 source IP(s) attempted authentication using widely-shared credential fingerprints (each fingerprint independently observed across ~31 other IPs) with no payload delivery and no infrastructure overlap beyond the shared credential list itself. Treated as background credential-stuffing noise, not attributed to a single actor or campaign -- credential reuse here is context, not identity evidence.
